description: Dark to medium gray quartzite, laminated quartzite, phyllite, and granofels

title: Moretown Formation
description: Interlayered gray and green quartz-sericite-chlorite-albite granofels, "pinstriped" granofels, and tan phyllite

title: Ultramafic rocks
description: One occurrence at the Barnes Hill Talc prospect; brown to white weathering, dark green, serpentinite and talc-carbonate rock

title: Stowe Formation
description: Green to gray quartz-sericite-chlorite phyllite and schist; black graphitic phyllite; abundant quartz veins; thin (1-10 m) interlayered greenstone is common at Chases Mountain. The contact between CZs and CZsws is gradational over approximately 100 meters and is marked by a gradual increase in grain size, principally of muscovite, and by the presence of garnet and kyanite

title: Stowe Formation
description: Gray-green laminated sandy schist and interlayered phyllite

title: Stowe Formation
description: Dark gray, quartz-sercite schist with albite porphyroblasts

title: Stowe Formation
description: Light to dark green, massive to foliated chlorite-epidote-albite-actinolite greenstone and calcareous greenstone; commonly with compositional layering defined by epidote-rich layers and pods

title: Stowe Formation
description: Bluish-silver to white, medium- to coarse-grained, spangly, chlorite-muscovite-quartz schist +/- albite, garnet, kyanite, and chloritoid with elongated quartz knots and pink coticule lenses; garnet is commonly partially to completely altered to chlorite and kyanite is commonly altered to sercite; quartz veins are abundant. The southern contact with CZs is gradational over approximately 100 meters and is marked by a gradual decrease in grain size, principally of muscovite, and by the absence of garnet and kyanite

title: Stowe Formation
description: Dark green to black, massive, medium- to coarse-grained, banded albite-epidote-hornblende amphibolite +/- garnet; contact with CZsws is generally sharp, and the units are interlayered; a distinctive medium to coarse-grained plagioclase-hornblende-magnetite meta-felsite occurs locally along both the upper and lower contacts of the amphibolite with the coarse-grained schists (CZsws)

title: Hazens Notch Formation
description: Dark gray and green, rusty-weathering, patchy graphitic, albitic muscovite-chlorite-quartz schist +/-pyrite; dark gray foliated quartzite; black graphitic phyllite; silver-gray calcareous and non-calcareous granofels occurs locally along contacts with greenstones

title: Hazens Notch Formation
description: Fine to medium grained, gray granofels and schist

title: Hazens Notch Formation
description: Gray and rusty weathering, black graphitic, sulfidic phyllite

title: Hazens Notch Formation
description: Light to dark green, massive to foliated chlorite-epidote-albite-actinolite greenstone and calcareous greenstone; commonly displays compositional layering defined by epidote-rich layers and pods
